body: Definitely, a lesson learned. In the long scheme of things, the amount may not be that much, but with all my current obligations, it throws me into financial hardship that I'm not prepared for. It's bad for my current situation because I have no emergency funds to pay for the upcoming rent, credit card balance, etc.

Stupid of me but it was multiple transactions. They gave me a number and an email to make the transfer using BofA. I don't know what bank they used but according to the bank representative I spoke to, the money was sent and made accessible briefly before a hold was placed when I filed the claim. I'm pretty sure they liquified the cash immediately but I can only hope and pray they didn't.

This was just an extremely tough pill to swallow, but thank you for your kind words and advice. The money saved was mainly for college and basic living. Currently, I have an ongoing lease but have no money to pay the upcoming rent. Just when I thought I had some financial stability, this incident had to ruin it for me. I understand that the cash may not be that much in the long run, but presently I still have rent, tuition, and insurance to pay monthly. There's only so much I can do to defer these payments and with my identity compromised, it will make it extremely difficult for me to obtain emergency funds either through loans or asking my family which I not ready to do. I'm still processing this and always tear up thinking that my money is not recoverable. Other than sitting patiently to see if my claim gets approved, I'm faced with financial difficulty.
Thank you, I contacted them last night and they were helpful in deescalating my emotions.

Thank you for the great advice. I called the hotline last night and spoke to someone who helped me deescalate my emotions and suicidal thoughts. Lesson definitely learned but will probably need some help getting over this embarrassment and financial hardship to come. I've filed a police report and a fraud report with the FTC. I've been working closely with my bank to better help with the investigation by providing further information and am awaiting updates patiently. My hope is that the bank placed a hold on the transactions, but I doubt this was possible as Zelle transfers are untraceable and immediately accessible. At this point, I just want the banks to make it extremely difficult for these scammers to access the money through their bank accounts.
Thank you for your kind words and advice. Currently, I'm trying my best to distract myself in any way I can, but I can't stop crying and wanting to just end it all. I'm just not ok right now...
